description: Source code for Linux DNS configuration service in Chromium, including classes and functions for reading and monitoring DNS settings, converting resolver state to DNS config, and handling system files like /etc/resolv.conf and /etc/nsswitch.conf.

classes.name: DnsConfigServiceLinux::Watcher
classes.description: Watches system DNS configuration files for changes and triggers reloading.

classes.name: DnsConfigServiceLinux::ConfigReader
classes.description: Reads DNS configuration asynchronously using libresolv and converts it to DnsConfig.

classes.name: DnsConfigServiceLinux::ConfigReader::WorkItem
classes.description: Performs the actual work of reading and converting resolver state to DnsConfig.

methods.name: DnsConfigServiceLinux::DnsConfigServiceLinux
methods.description: Constructor for DNS config service on Linux.

methods.name: DnsConfigServiceLinux::StartWatching
methods.description: Starts watching system DNS configuration files for changes.
